# MAP HEAT RESEARCH

You research the **top-2 SPX/RUT captains** supplied by the mechanical map.
Post-close batches cover every industry with a liquid captain; the morning
batch refreshes only hot/cold/OVERRIDE/calendar names. You do **not** write
stock essays.
You do **not** re-describe the heatmap.

## Job 1 — captain cards (JSON first)

Input is a compact board: industry, parent residual, SPX captains, RUT captains,
tape, calendar. For each industry:

1. Look up current ticker-tagged news and X on **only those tickers**.
2. Decide sub-sector direction from the captains + residual, not from the parent ETF.
3. Sentiment is pos / neg / mixed / none from **today's** evidence, not the keyword stub.

Return ONE fenced json block first:

```json
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "cards": [
    {
      "industry": "Uranium",
      "sector": "Energy",
      "action": "OVERRIDE",
      "subsector_dir": "up",
      "conviction": "medium",
      "captains": [
        {
          "ticker": "UEC",
          "index": "RUT",
          "sent": "pos",
          "why": "one line",
          "evidence": [
            {
              "source": "Reuters",
              "url": "https://...",
              "published_at": "2026-08-26T06:15:00-04:00",
              "fact": "specific fact that changed sentiment"
            }
          ],
          "x_sentiment": {
            "used": true,
            "label": "pos",
            "mention_delta_24h": 1.4,
            "sample_urls": ["https://x.com/..."],
            "reason": ""
          },
          "search_note": "queries attempted; required when sent=none"
        }
      ],
      "one_line": "Energy ETF is oil-weak; uranium captains confirm the nested long.",
      "do_not": "bury in XLE DOWN"
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules:
- `subsector_dir` is up / down / flat.
- `conviction` is high / medium / low. High only if both captains agree AND news agrees with the tape residual.
- Skip an industry if it has zero liquid captains — do not invent tickers.
- Return one card for every supplied industry. Never invent a ticker that was
  not in the supplied SPX/RUT captain list.
- A non-`none` sentiment without a current URL, timestamp and specific fact is
  INVALID. Price movement alone is not sentiment.
- `none` is honest and acceptable, but include `search_note`.
- X is required only in the morning hot-list refresh. If unavailable, set
  `x_sentiment.used=false`; never fake mention counts.
- one_line ≤ 160 chars. why ≤ 120 chars.

## Job 2 — opportunity synthesis (JSON first)

You see the full map-heat board PLUS the captain cards. Answer only:

**Where is money moving that the 11 sector ETFs will miss or mislabel?**

```json
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "size_gate": true,
  "size_gate_reason": "PCE 08:30 + NVDA AMC",
  "parent_splits": [
    {
      "sector": "Energy",
      "long": ["Uranium"],
      "avoid": ["Oil & Gas Integrated"],
      "why": "oil tape red, uranium captains bid"
    }
  ],
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "id": "uranium_nested",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["UEC", "UUUU"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs Energy; RUT captains pos",
      "horizon": "1w"
    }
  ],
  "vetoes": [
    {"what": "XLK notable UP", "why": "NVDA print tonight; size_gate"}
  ],
  "one_paragraph": "four to six sentences. no essay."
}
```

Hard rules:
- If size_gate is on, do not promote a broad SPX/XLK "UP notable".
- Nested OVERRIDE is the product. Never average uranium into Energy.
- Tickers in opportunities MUST appear as captains (or be the obvious liquid leader already on the card). No $20m names.
- one_paragraph is the only prose. JSON first.

CAPTAIN_CARDS_OK
OPPORTUNITY_OK


[RESEARCH MODE] You have native web search and X search — use them yourself to research live sources before answering; there is no external search tool in this conversation. Produce the required output exactly as specified above, then append a final section titled RESEARCH APPENDIX listing the queries you ran, the key sources (title + URL + timestamp where available), and the specific facts you took from each. Never invent sources.

```json
{
  "date": "2026-08-31",
  "size_gate": false,
  "size_gate_reason": "Post-close baseline only; overnight futures and calendar refresh pre-open. No morning size_gate.",
  "parent_splits": [
    {
      "sector": "Basic Materials",
      "long": ["Other Industrial Metals & Mining", "Steel", "Copper", "Coking Coal"],
      "avoid": ["Chemicals", "Lumber & Wood Production"],

    },
    {

      "long": [],

    },
    {

    },
    {

      "side": "long",

    },
    {

      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["HCC"],
      "why": "SPLIT vs XLB; Blue Creek volumes, not AMR DTA cut",

    },
    {
      "id": "steel_nested",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["NUE", "STLD", "NWPX"],

    },
    {

      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["KSS"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs XLY DOWN; FY raise/buybacks, comps still red",
      "horizon": "1w"
    }
  ],
  "vetoes": [
    {"what": "XLK notable UP", "why": "close-to-close +3.16 is index tape, not a nested captain product"},
    {"what": "XLB materials long", "why": "averages chem/lumber OVERRIDE into USAR/MTRN/IE/HCC/steel"},
    {"what": "AMR with HCC", "why": "AMR cut FY met tons on DTA storm; pair is a SPLIT"},
    {"what": "FCX as copper", "why": "no August company print; live tell is IE EXIM PPL"},
    {"what": "NMAX/FUBO as XLC long", "why": "broadcast residual deeply red; headlines do not confirm"},
    {"what": "HAS/LTH/GOLF or PII/HOG as XLY thaw", "why": "pos news vs flagged cold leisure/RV residuals"},
    {"what": "MDLZ/HSY confectioners long", "why": "beats vs w1 residual still -2.4 vs XLP"},
    {"what": "XOM/CVX as XLE long", "why": "Permian/Angola news vs oil_majors w1 -1.62"},
    {"what": "BF-B inside XLP", "why": "family letter + dead Pernod + rejected Sazerac into weak sales"},
    {"what": "WS in the steel bid", "why": "Kloeckner tender/impairment mixed vs NUE/STLD/NWPX ops"}
  ],
  "one_paragraph": "XLB closed -0.82 while materials breadth was 0.60 and copper/steel residuals ran; the ETF is a chemicals-and-lumber average that buries USAR’s DoW-backed $1.55bn Serra Verde SPV, MTRN’s AI/semi guide-up, IE’s EXIM Santa Cruz PPL, HCC’s Blue Creek volumes, and NUE/STLD/NWPX mill and water-pipe prints. XLY/XLP/XLC all printed red: KSS is the only discretionary OVERRIDE (FY raise and $100m buybacks against an 18th down-comp quarter and Sephora -4%), while NKE 52-week lows and cold leisure/RV residuals veto treating HAS/PII/HOG headlines as an XLY thaw. BF-B’s family/M&A mess is the XLP hide; Mondelez/Hershey beats do not confirm a still-red confectioners residual. Oil majors’ Permian and Angola news is real but oil_majors w1 is -1.62 — do not relabel Energy. This is a post-close nested map, not a pre-open size call; XLK’s +3.16 close is the index tape, not the product."
}
```

## RESEARCH APPENDIX

**Queries run**
- USA Rare Earth USAR Serra Verde SPV Department of War August 2026
- Ivanhoe Electric IE EXIM Santa Cruz $1.1 billion PPL August 2026
- Warrior Met Coal HCC Q2 2026 Blue Creek sales guidance
- Materion MTRN raised FY2026 EPS guidance semiconductor AI
- Kohl's KSS Q2 2026 earnings raise buybacks Sephora
- Nucor NUE Steel Dynamics STLD Q2 2026 earnings steel demand
- USA Rare Earth USAR Serra Verde shareholder vote August 28 2026 result
- Brown-Forman BF-B family letter Sazerac Pernod August 2026
- NWPX Infrastructure Q2 2026 water transmission backlog

**Key sources and facts used**
- GlobeNewswire / Valor / DoW (2026-08-24): USAR completed $1.55bn SPV cap — DoW $750m equity, $500m revolver commitment, ≥$300m 5-year forward purchase for Serra Verde offtake. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/24/3349611/0/en/usa-rare-earth-nasdaq-usar-announces-completion-of-upsized-1-55-billion-capitalization-of-the-u-s-government-backed-special-purpose-vehicle-spv-for-serra-verde-offtake.html
- Vote status (as of 2026-08-28 meeting day): USAR Serra Verde special meeting scheduled 10:00 AM EDT; no certified 8-K result in search — did **not** treat the deal as closed. https://www.boardroomalpha.com/meetings/usar-2026-special-meeting-aug
- Ivanhoe Electric PR / Mining.com (2026-08-24): EXIM PPL up to $1.1bn for Santa Cruz (from $825m LOI); not a final commitment; PFS due Sep 2026. https://ivanhoeelectric.com/site/assets/files/11207/2026-08-24-pr-santa-cruz-receives-exim-ppl-final-v2.pdf
- Motley Fool HCC transcript (call 2026-08-05): Q2 sales 3.7mst, adj. EBITDA $156.9m; FY sales guide 13.0–14.0mst on Blue Creek. https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/12/warrior-met-coal-hcc-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/
- Materion IR / Fool (Q2 print ~2026-08-05/07): FY26 adj. EPS raised to $6.80–$7.20 on semi/AI/space demand. https://investor.materion.com/news/news-details/2026/Materion-Corporation-Reports-Record-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Raises-Full-Year-Outlook/default.aspx
- Kohl’s PR / Reuters / JSOnline (2026-08-26/27): sales $3.32B, comps -0.9%; FY adj. EPS $1.80–$2.40; $100M buybacks; Sephora -4%. https://corporate.kohls.com/news/kohls-reports-second-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results
- Nucor PR (2026-07-28): adj. EPS $4.84, sales ~$10.4bn, record mill shipments; trade/infra demand. https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/nucor-reports-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026-302835608.html
- Steel Dynamics IR (Q2 2026): EPS $3.69, record 3.7mst shipments. https://ir.steeldynamics.com/steel-dynamics-reports-second-quarter-2026-results/
- NWPX PR / 8-K (2026-07-29/30): record Q2 sales $159.5m, EPS $1.62; WTS signed backlog $305m. https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/nwpx-infrastructure-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-302838109.html
